name: Concordia Cooperative Intelligence Challenge
description: Develop and evaluate autonomous language model agents capable of cooperative reasoning, communication, and decision-making in diverse, mixed-motive, text-mediated environments to maximize joint welfare.

cr:input.name: Concordia simulation environments
cr:input.description: Text-based descriptions of environments and interactions, event logs, and grounded variables. Examples include scenarios such as managing a fishery, negotiating a treaty, and participating in a reality game show. Input data includes natural language descriptions from the Game Master (GM) about the current game state and background memories initialized at the start of each episode.
cr:input.contentUrl: [FILL IN THE BLANK: dataset download URL]

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: Free-form natural language outputs describing intended actions or communications. Outputs must align with the scenario's context and demonstrate cooperative reasoning and decision-making. Examples include proposing a treaty clause or suggesting a resource-sharing strategy.

field.name: action_description
field.description: Free-form text describing the agent's intended action or communication. Example: 'Propose a treaty clause to share resources equally.'

packages: [FILL IN THE BLANK: exact package versions for Concordia framework and dependencies]

cr:evaluation.primaryMetric: Quantitative scores based on cooperative intelligence
metrics: Quantitative scores based on cooperative intelligence
Qualitative transcript analysis for cooperative skills
cr:evaluation.notes: Scores are assigned by LM-based reward models based on outcomes generated by the Game Master. Final scores are averaged across environments, co-player populations, and replications.
